assertions.name: no_i1_no_probe_blocks
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = every clean-Lean block has a probe witness)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every provable block with proven Lean is exercised by a probe at q_0.

description: I1 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: every provable content block (theorem / proposition / lemma / corollary) is cross-checked against the union of all witness `contentBlock` fields.  Blocks with proven Lean (0 sorrys, or class+sorry via §3b-cond) but no probe witness are flagged as `i1_no_probe`. Blocks with `sorry` (without conditional-class) belong to the proof-integration-watcher's queue; blocks without any `.lean` sibling are `i1_pre_lean` (deeper gap).
